Independent Innovator disposition

I inspected the public repository CartmanFatass/My-paper-code at the exact origin-reachable commit 2b8f1ae0ea8c514bd333c45fe11275a2fabfbb81; the connector resolved that exact SHA rather than the current branch head.

I read all seven specified references at that commit. The public direction records the retained position as “expressibility/selectivity passed, but utility and allocation improvement were zero.” The science card defines the later request as source, the true older waiter’s physical change as target, and the later source record as the sole relay destination; it leaves the waiter’s own GAE untouched, replaces rather than adds the tagged interaction atom, and matches update norm, work, and fixed-token evaluation. The retained result and technical intake report that all calibration gates passed, but INTACT−GAE native utility, yoked utility, and native-minus-yoked interaction were exactly zero at every one of twelve roots; only the contrast against the binding cut was positive.

The configuration, experiment, and runner confirm the frozen roots, one-step normalized update, source-row-only replacement, common displacement, complete fixed-token evaluator, and calibration-before-confirmation sequencing. I use those as old-host estimator semantics, not as an implementation-quality judgment.

I treat the T3 findings solely as user-supplied terminal science and do not attribute them to this commit.

Conclusion

No full survivor exists in the three-family search.

All three strongest canonical constructions possess genuine association-specific physical paths. The first two give the source action a maximal unit-sized favorable-versus-harmful effect; the third contains real persistence, censoring, and physical substitution. They do not fail for lack of expressibility, path length, interaction magnitude, or discrete decision sensitivity.

They fail at an earlier and stronger gate:

Given the same finite tapes, edge locators, causal observations, transformations, routing rules, and work, a competent generic conditional or Rao–Blackwellized estimator exactly reproduces the association-aware population update.

Consequently, after the same preconditioner and trust map:

the association update has zero orthogonal component relative to the generic update;

it changes no scarce decision relative to the generic estimator;

favorable-allocation and normalized-utility gains are exactly zero;

and the native-minus-severed association interaction is exactly zero.

This is a comparator-absorption result, not a claim that the physical associations are absent.

The candidate is a valid estimator of external utility.

The candidate intentionally changes the target to exploit normalization, curvature, or finite-step behavior.

Why complementarity and curvature do not rescue it

The nonlinear object is the ordered path product, but conditional Q is precisely its conditional expectation:

Q(H,a)=E[1{first hop succeeds}1{second hop succeeds}∣H,a].

A candidate could deliberately reweight the first and second hop to obtain a different finite-step direction. But under the frozen comparison:

the generic estimator receives the same path decomposition;

it may Rao–Blackwellize the transformed routed targets record by record;

and it can therefore reproduce that direction exactly.

If the generic arm were prohibited from doing so, the contrast would be against a restricted optimizer or restricted target class, not against a competent same-information generic estimator.

Rejection

Earliest failed gate: noncollinearity against generic conditional Q/Rao–Blackwellization.

Again:

orthogonal fraction: 0;

differing scarce decisions: none;

favorable-allocation gain: 0 out of span 1;

normalized utility gain: 0;

native-minus-severed interaction: 0.

Disposition: reject.

This is the strongest mechanistic countercase to a simple one-hop/additive explanation. Its failure shows that path length and multiplicative complementarity alone do not create information beyond exact conditional action value.

Why the searched escape routes do not work

Multi-record interference.
The generic value conditions on the complete live-record state. It includes displacement of the competing queue record rather than treating records additively.

Multi-step complementarity.
Products, gates, and ordered path completion alter the numerical Q table but do not escape conditional sufficiency.

Shared policy parameters.
The equality is record-wise before the score contributions are summed. Adding common later-record gradients preserves equality.

Censoring and substitution.
The pathwise target conditions on the realized carrier. Conditional Q integrates over exactly that carrier law; Rao–Blackwellization removes rather than loses information relevant to the source action.

Batch normalization or clipping.
Define C
r
	​

 after the transformation. The generic estimator can conditional-average that transformed target. A global positive scale is also removed by the common trust map.

Finite-step curvature.
A deliberately biased, curvature-aware target may outperform the true gradient at a particular radius, but the generic arm receives the same decomposition or model prediction and can reproduce it. Such a result would establish a finite-step optimizer or surrogate-objective effect, not a need for association-aware credit.

Finite-sample noise.
The requested analysis is over the exact finite distribution. Sampling noise cannot create an admissible difference. With finite samples, Rao–Blackwellization would ordinarily favor the generic estimator’s variance, not the association target’s.

Narrow no-survivor claim

The defensible claim is:

In these three smallest symmetry-respecting finite topologies, under one exact population update, equal action-time information, equal event and causal objects, equal routing capability, equal model and policy classes, equal useful work, and a common preconditioner/trust/evaluation map, no association-aware source-to-waiter credit target can establish a noncollinear or decision-useful advantage over a competent generic conditional-Q or Rao–Blackwellized estimator. The three canonical instances fail even though their association-specific physical effects are large and externally consequential.

This does not establish:

a general impossibility theorem for association-aware learning;

equivalence with learned, misspecified, or capacity-limited critics;

multi-update equivalence;

sample-efficiency equivalence;

value under changing populations;

relay value in other hosts;

transfer, UAV relevance, safety, or deployment value.

Strongest countercase and future reentry

The serial two-hop instance is the strongest mechanistic countercase because reward is generated only by an ordered source–waiter–downstream path. The censored substitution instance is the strongest statistical countercase because the physical carrier can persist, disappear, or change identity. Neither produces information unavailable to exact generic conditioning.

A genuinely different reentry would have to stop asking an exact-population sufficiency question. The credible next object is:

A finite-data, finite-compute approximation test in which exact conditional Q is unavailable, both estimators receive identical trajectories and keys, and an association-factorized critic competes with a competent generic critic under a prospectively frozen parameter, FLOP, memory, update, and data budget.

That object could test whether association factorization improves sample or approximation efficiency. It could not claim that association contains information absent from generic Q. Before execution, it would need to freeze the approximation bottleneck, critic classes, computation accounting, event-key access, data reuse, optimizer state, and discrete allocation/utility endpoints. A flexible generic critic must remain able to represent the association-factorized solution; otherwise the comparison again confounds credit with representation.

Common failure risk for finite-host credit research

The recurring risk is to mistake a causally meaningful decomposition for additional decision-relevant information.

A finite host can establish all of the following:

a real ordered source-to-waiter path;

a large path-specific counterfactual effect;

balanced identity marginals;

an expressive source-record update;

a changed score covariance or probability;

and a clean severing intervention,

while still offering no value beyond conditional action value. Once an exact generic estimator receives the same event key and causal observations, association labels either:

integrate to the same policy gradient, leaving only variance or magnitude differences; or

change the objective or optimizer geometry in a way a same-information generic estimator can reproduce.

That is the common danger exposed jointly by the public B1 result, the supplied T3 constraint, and this pre-relay search: physical association is necessary for causal interpretation, but it is not by itself sufficient for scarce-decision value over exact generic credit.
